request_user:
Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Code, checkpoints and training details are released. Repositories: Open-Instruct (DPO and RLVR) https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct; OLMo-Core (pre-training and SFT) https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core; OLMo-Eval (evaluation) https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-Eval. Intermediate checkpoints are available as HuggingFace revisions (naming step_XXXX, e.g. revision="step_1375"), though only the final few are released for this model. Training datasets are linked on Hugging Face (e.g. Dolci-Instruct-SFT, Dolci-Instruct-DPO, Dolci-Instruct-RL). Logs are coming soon.
quotes: We are releasing all code, checkpoints, logs (coming soon), and associated training details.
- Open-Instruct for DPO and RLVR: https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct
- OLMo-Core for pre-training and SFT: https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core
We have released checkpoints for these models. For post-training, the naming convention is `step_XXXX`.
